title: Huntsman Declares $0.0875 Cash Dividend for Fourth Quarter 2026
summary: Huntsman's board declared a $0.0875 per share cash dividend, payable December 11, 2026, to stockholders of record as of November 27, 2026.
body_markdown:
The dividend is payable on Friday, December 11, 2026, to stockholders of record as of Friday, November 27, 2026. The release does not state an ex-dividend date, and it does not say how the amount compares with the company's previous dividend.


## Why It Matters for HUN


The declaration sets the cash amount per share that stockholders of record on November 27, 2026 are due to receive on December 11, 2026. The release describes Huntsman as a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical products, with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from its continuing operations.


According to the company, its chemical products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse range of consumer and industrial end markets. Huntsman says it operates more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employs approximately 6,000 associates within its continuing operations. The release also lists risks that may affect the company, including volatile global economic conditions and cyclical and volatile product markets.
